classification.question_topic: Asking if others have been in similar recurring 'library' locations

meta.occupation_in_dream: hired as some kind of security guard (by library leaders)

locations.location_name: Typical large library with mirrors/laser ghost detection

qualities.raw_description: “typical looking library… large… various mirrors that bounce a laser around the place to detect ghosts.”

Outside and inside looks like “a huge cathedral… a church.” Inside: “to the left, are a row of table… seems to go on and on.” Opposite: “rows and rows of aisles full of books.” “book shelfs just go up and up to infinity.” “dark… illuminated by small torches on the walls… very medieval.” “suits of armor throughout… two near the entrance… more at the end of all the book shelfs.” “large fireplace at the very end but I never seem to get near it.” “often people sitting here and there reading.”

locations.location_name: Small circular wooden library with spiral staircase and caged elevator

position.relative_to: must pass through this library to reach another library

qualities.raw_description: “small in appearance… only seen the inside.” “walls are wooden.” “main area is circular… a ton of large wooden tables… some have computers.” “walls all around are actually bookshelves… go up 6 stories or more.” “huge spiral staircase… in the far back… made of wood.” “Directly behind this, is a caged elevator… takes you to the upper floors or directly to other library.” “Everyone… seem to be working there… part of some group working in secrecy.”

position.relative_to: reached by elevator going down several floors from the wooden library

qualities.raw_description: “large security room.” “large windows that look out to this underground library.” “a bunch of tv monitors in here.” Also referred to as “security center.”

position.relative_to: viewable from security room windows; accessed via elevator from wooden library

qualities.raw_description: “secret library… can’t tell anyone.” “huge… goes on and on and on.” “all white, sterile. Sanitized. Everything is clean.” “half a library and half a museum.” “artifacts… enclosed in glass cabinets… weapons of all kinds… masks from all over the world… ancient things including books.” “rows and rows of books. Aisle upon aisle.” “books… contain incantations and I cannot read them.”

position.relative_to: another smaller room within/near the underground secret library

qualities.raw_description: “another smaller room. A vault.” “more dangerous artifacts… especially… jewelry in small boxes.” “books and similar things like the main library.”

connections.qualities: “huge spiral staircase… in the far back… made of wood” leading to upper floors (bookshelves go up “6 stories or more”).
“caged elevator” behind the spiral staircase; “We get on the elevator and we do down several floor” to the security room.
Caged elevator “takes you to the upper floors or directly to other library.”
Security room has “large windows that look out to this underground library.”
“they then take me to another smaller room. A vault.”
“After a while we have to rush out and back to the security center.”

interactions.description: Dreamer is repeatedly “hired by them” and asked to be “some kind of security guard.”

entities_involved.description: Old man with grey hair, bald on top; “always dressed in a dark business suit with a black tie”; “seems to be nice.”
Young woman “early twenties” with “dark shoulder length hair”; “usually wearing a sweater… different color” and “a black skirt.”

interactions.description: Dreamer is told the underground area is a “secret library” and “I can't tell anyone about it.”

entities_involved.description: Old man in dark suit and young woman in sweater/skirt (leaders).

interactions.description: Dreamer is shown artifacts in glass cabinets and extensive aisles of books; told everything is dangerous and cannot be touched; books contain incantations and dreamer cannot read them.

entities_involved.description: Old man and young woman guiding/explaining rules about the secret library.

interactions.description: After time in the vault/underground area, they “rush out and back to the security center”; told staying too long leads to being “influenced by evil” and “maybe even die.”

entities_involved.description: Old man and young woman urging quick return and warning about danger of staying out too long.

interactions.description: Dreamer observes endless tables on the left, book aisles opposite, suits of armor, and a distant fireplace they never reach; people sit reading.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post describes several distinct recurring library settings. The author labels “2nd and 3rd” as connected; extracted as a wooden circular library connected via caged elevator to an underground sterile secret library/museum, plus a separate cathedral-like library and a separate typical library. Exact ordering across visits and exact connection from security room to underground floor is not fully specified beyond elevator use and window overlook.
